title: Facility double-booking: no overlap/capacity check
expected: Exactly one reservation wins an overlapping window; capacity bounds concurrency
actual: Both Go BookFacility and BFF bookings POST inserted unconditionally; unlimited double-booking possible
root_cause: No conflict check and no DB exclusion constraint on facility_bookings
fix_commit: (this branch) overlap+capacity guard added in both paths; durable race guard pending in docs/qa/estate-uat-443/migrations-estate-c/facility_booking_overlap_exclusion.pending.sql

title: Vendor jobs exposed to and mutable by any resident (BFF)
expected: Jobs visible only to estate admin and the assigned vendor; lifecycle moves by owner/admin only
actual: GET listed every vendor job (names+amounts) to any resident; POST status let any resident flip any job
root_cause: Routes checked estate membership only, never vendor ownership
fix_commit: (this branch) GET scoped admin|own-vendor|403; status POST requires admin or owning vendor

title: Emergency alert list leaked all reporters and incident details to every resident
expected: Sensitive contact/medical details hidden except authorized responders
actual: Any resident could list every alert incl. reporter_id, description, location of other units (BFF even resolved reporter names)
root_cause: List queries filtered by estate_id only, never by reporter or role
fix_commit: (this branch) responders (estate_admin/estate_security) see all; residents see own alerts only

title: Repair request list leaked all residents' tickets + reporter names (BFF)
expected: Residents see their own tickets; admins see the queue (Go ListRepairs already did this)
actual: BFF returned all estate repairs with resolved reporter names to any resident
root_cause: BFF lacked the non-admin reporter_id filter present in the Go service
fix_commit: (this branch) non-admin list scoped to reporter_id = caller

title: Pending/suspended vendors listed in resident marketplace
expected: Only verified vendors visible in marketplace search; unapproved vendors blocked until admin approval
actual: All statuses (pending, suspended) returned to every resident
root_cause: List queries had no role-aware status filter
fix_commit: (this branch) non-admin listing forced to status=verified

title: Notification opt-out preferences stored but never enforced
expected: Per-category push opt-out respected; life-safety notices still delivered
actual: estate_member_settings toggles existed and were editable but notify()/notifyMembers() never read them
root_cause: Delivery path ignored the settings table
fix_commit: (this branch) pushAllowed() consults push_enabled + per-category toggle before push; security category exempt; in-app feed always persists

title: No resident sign-off or reopen path on repair tickets
expected: Resident can accept the fix (close) or reject it (reopen with audit); only under sign-off rules
actual: Only estate admins could change repair status; residents had no accept/reject action at all
fix_commit: (this branch) PATCH repairs/[id] {action:accept|reject} reporter-only, state-gated, appends repair_updates audit

title: Vendor job decline captured no reason
expected: Decline reason tracked for reassignment obligations
actual: Reject endpoint accepted no body; reason lost
root_cause: No reason parameter on the transition
fix_commit: (this branch) RejectJobWithReason persists reason to estate_audit_log

title: Document downloads produced no audit event
expected: Document retrieval is a privileged, audited event
actual: Download-URL issuance (both presigned and legacy paths) wrote no audit row
root_cause: Missing audit call in the download handler
fix_commit: (this branch) DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD audit on both issuance paths

title: Fee-based facility booking can never be confirmed: no payment/confirm endpoint
expected: Reservation becomes confirmed only after appropriate payment state
actual: fee>0 bookings are created pending and stay pending forever; no pay endpoint exists in Go or BFF
root_cause: Payment/capture flow for booking fees was never built (needs ledger integration)

title: Booking cancellation has no refund-cutoff policy or ledger refund
expected: Policy-specific refund and inventory release inside/outside cutoff
actual: Cancel flips status to cancelled only; refunded status exists in schema but is never set; no money movement
root_cause: Refund policy + ledger reversal not implemented

title: Procurement model absent: no RFQ/bids/contracts/authority-matrix/three-way-match/credential-expiry/ratings/renewals/spend summary
actual: Vendor directory + job pipeline exist; RFQ, sealed bids with deadlines, contract entity, conflict declarations, credential expiry, rating endpoint, renewal and spend reporting do not
root_cause: Feature never built (schema + services needed, beyond lane fix scope)

title: Document governance absent: versioning/approval/expiration/ack/e-sign/soft-delete/bulk-export/malware-scan/magic-byte-type-check/presign-size-binding
actual: Upload+restricted list+presigned download work; everything governance-related is missing; size check is client-declared only

title: Announcement governance absent: targeting/draft-approve/scheduling/pin/attachments/edit-history/mandatory-ack/moderation/per-channel delivery tracking
expected: Targeted, approvable, schedulable notices per REQ-M15
actual: Create+list+read-receipt work; every governance capability is missing

title: Incident workflow absent: ack/escalation/geo-target/responder-failover/false-report-control/resident-cancel/update-feed/resolution-evidence/reopen-justification/response-metrics
actual: Raise/list/resolve + guard incident reports work; acknowledgement, escalation timers, targeting, failover, abuse control, cancel and evidence fields do not

title: Asset & maintenance planning absent: asset tags/registry/warranty/SLA rules/preventive schedules/blackout calendar/meter readings/projects/quote-approval thresholds/closure flag
expected: Asset registry and planned maintenance per REQ-M12
actual: Facilities CRUD + repair tickets + vendor jobs work; every asset/SLA/planning capability is missing

title: Report exports absent: CSV/XLSX/PDF, async jobs, scheduled email, PII minimisation/watermark, data-as-of stamps, rent roll, expense side
actual: Live aggregates + dashboards exist; no export formats, jobs, schedules or PII controls

title: Anonymous issue submission unsupported
expected: Permitted anonymous common-area reports hide reporter identity from ordinary viewers
actual: reporter_id is NOT NULL, always stored and returned
root_cause: No anonymous flag or masking path
